  <text x="195" y="424" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Open Sans, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="17" font-weight="400" fill="#777777">We’ll let you know when something</text>
  <text x="195" y="446" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Open Sans, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="17" font-weight="400" fill="#777777">new happens with your bookings.</text>

    <rect x="0" y="0" width="342" height="50" rx="5" fill="#007AFF"/>
